motor_mass_assumption: Entire actuator catalogue mass at envelope centre on fixed carrier. Its own output-side mass is unknown; own-joint support wrench excludes that mass, while upstream gravitational torque includes it. No measured CAD mass properties.
structure_budget_note: 1.40 kg nominal bookkeeping allowance, not a measured or CAD-derived mass. Covers added brackets, links, bearings, housing and wires; excludes motors, detachable head, fixed base and workpiece. Sensitivity 0.84 to 2.24 kg is not a certified bound.
limitations: Static gravity only. No speed, acceleration, reflected rotor inertia, friction, cable torque, shock or contact process forces.
All wrench moments are reported at the kinematic joint origin, not at a confirmed physical bearing or flange plane.
Motor centre-of-mass and output mass split remain unverified.
Only existing A05 proxy collision pairs are screened; no continuous collision or cable sweep proof.
Catalogue rated torque is a comparator, not the enclosed arm's continuous zero-speed holding capacity.
Structure allowance and head mass are scenarios, not revised requirements or selected manufactured masses.
